channel.description: Latest articles from Austin County News Online (austincountynewsonline.com)

item.title: Armed Man in Tactical Gear Enters Klein ISD Elementary, Released on $75K Bond
item.description: Parents are outraged after the Zwink Elementary armed entry suspect was released on $75,000 bond with only house arrest. Full details on the Klein school incident, tactical gear, and safety petition here.

item.title: No. 15 Blinn Sweeps Coastal Bend For Perfect Start To Region 14 South Play
item.description: The Buccaneers pushed their winning streak to four and improved to 16-4 overall

item.title: How To Get Rid Of Fire Ants: Expert Tips That Work
item.description: Fire ant mounds popping up? Learn why they appear, when activity peaks, and the most effective way to eliminate entire colonies—not just the ones you see.

item.title: Behind the Badge: The Hidden Mental Health Crisis Among First Responders
item.description: First responders see and experience things most people never will. This article explores the mental health challenges they face and how communities can support the people who protect and serve.

item.title: Prairie Chickens Get 500 Acres in Colorado County
item.description: The Attwater Prairie Chicken National Wildlife Refuge in Colorado County has expanded by more than 500 acres, strengthening habitat for one of Texas’ most endangered birds.

item.title: Bronze Cannonball Discovered at the Alamo Ahead of 190th Anniversary
item.description: Archaeologists at the Alamo have uncovered a rare bronze cannonball believed to date to the 1836 siege, adding a remarkable new piece to the story of one of Texas’ most historic battles.

item.title: Artificial Intelligence is Reshaping the Dairy Industry
item.description: Researchers at Texas A&M AgriLife are developing AI-powered systems that help dairy farmers monitor cattle health, improve efficiency, and make faster, more informed decisions.

item.title: Children’s Ibuprofen Recall Affects Nearly 90,000 Bottles Nationwide
item.description: A nationwide recall of nearly 90,000 bottles of children’s ibuprofen is urging parents to check lot numbers and stop using affected products immediately.

item.title: Today in History: The First “OK” Is Printed
item.description: On March 23, 1839, “OK” appeared in print for the first time in The Boston Morning Post. What started as slang for “oll korrect” became one of the world’s most recognized words.

item.title: New Moons Found Around Jupiter and Saturn
item.description: Astronomers have identified 15 new moons orbiting Jupiter and Saturn, adding to the growing list of known moons and offering new clues about the solar system’s violent past.
